== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[Son Of Skywalker (V)#Source formats|Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]: the region (148, 644, 692, 940) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif Holotable commit efc26cd] (2024-12-29). The matching after crop is [[:File:V24-L-sonofskywalker-2025-08-06-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif commit efc26cd]) and [[Son Of Skywalker (V)#Source formats|Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/949615388238cb4257bda7343316b6d6df5cd56c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif commit 9496153]).
